prepared_arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer. Final targeted revision of the close dialogue portrait in Image 1. Image 1 is the edit target; Image 2 is Lein's original identity master, and Images 3–6 are strict low-resolution facial-cluster style references. Keep her established identity: a weathered woman in her thirties, wide cheekbones, warm tan skin, brown outward-flipping short hair, a snug soft brown brimmed hat holding ONE short chalk with a brown loop obscuring its middle, deep muted forest-green cape collar.
Make these corrections together: her eyes must become SMALL narrow dark slits with only tiny muted ochre-gray sclera accents, NOT large cream-white wedges. Reduce each eye's height strongly and eliminate all bright white in the eyes. Flatten the currently high-raised inner brows into nearly level natural brows with only a very subtle asymmetry: she is alert and earnestly explaining a correction, not anxious or pleading. Keep a small lightly parted explanatory mouth. Broaden the NOSE and CHEEKBONE lighting into a few simple connected planes; no delicate smooth portrait shading.
Composition correction: move the chin LOW to about logical y=88; shorten the visible neck to only 3–4 pixels; show just a narrow 5–7 pixel deep-green collar at the bottom. NO broad shoulders, chest or long V-neck. Keep the face large: compact the hat crown and side hair volume without deleting their recognizable silhouette. The original hat brim, single chalk, hair tips and visible ear must be complete. Leave at least 2 logical pixels of ACTUAL transparency at left/right and above the crown, and 1 below the collar. Do not crop.
74×100 logical pixels, crisp blocky medieval RPG dialogue-portrait look. Use 3–4 large connected hair masses rather than repeated thin highlights. 32 or fewer flat earthy colors, sharp stepped boundaries, transparent background. Match the coarse mature facial anatomy of Images 3–6. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, hatch lines, dithering, white eye blocks, exaggerated sorrow, decorative texture, text or props outside her hat. One portrait.
